question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 6, 4 and 10 days, respectively. If they are working together, then the number of days they will take to complete the same work is:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 6 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 4 days

Time taken by C to complete the work = 10 days

**Formula Used:**

Combined work rate = (1/A's rate) + (1/B's rate) + (1/C's rate)

Time taken to complete the work together = 1 / Combined work rate

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A = 1/6

Work rate of B = 1/4

Work rate of C = 1/10

Combined work rate = (1/6) + (1/4) + (1/10)

⇒ Combined work rate = (1)/(6) + (1)/(4) + (1)/(10)

⇒ Combined work rate = (10 + 15 + 6)/(60)

⇒ Combined work rate = (31)/(60)

Time taken to complete the work together = 1 / Combined work rate

⇒ Time taken = (60)/(31)

⇒ Time taken = 1(29)/(31) days

**The correct answer is option 1:** 1frac{{29}}{{31}} \frac{29}{31}
